title: 第12章 包圆第13章 仙果
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
那时林鹤清才八岁，养了些兔子玩。
突发奇想想看看灵液对动物有没有什么影响。
于是林鹤清就等买的四只兔子生了许多小宝宝，偷偷将两只小兔子放在空间里养着，喂兔子吃他改良了三次的甜梨。
一颗甜梨种子，种下去，加一滴灵液，最后那次结的甜梨摘下来吃掉。
得到的种子再种下去，再滴一滴灵液，又结果子，然后再来一次，一共得到了三颗梨树。
第一棵梨树，长得不大，然后倒是挺多的，梨子吃起来也就比外面的梨甜了一点点。
但是第三棵梨树，果实吃起来没有很甜，果子结的也不多，一棵树就结了二十个梨子。
梨子吃起来是爽口清脆的，林鹤清叫第三棵树上面结的果子为“月白梨”，梨子又大又白又圆，像天上的圆月。
兔子稍微大点，林鹤清就借口生的太多了，把兔子全部卖了，只留了两只公兔子在院子里，平时偶尔喂喂，也长得挺好。
母兔子太能生了，林鹤清怕了都。
实际上，生了兔宝宝的时候，宝宝太多，而且兔子稍微大一点就又会繁殖了。
林鹤清就放了两只兔子在空间里，一直也没有人发现。
同时给兔子喂三种梨的时候，月白梨明显受欢迎，吃过月白梨以后，即使林鹤清没有及时摘月白梨，兔子也不会吃其他两种梨。
第一次吃月白梨的时候，两只兔子倒是吃的欢，结果吃完，兔子睡了两天，林鹤清以为它们死了，还庆幸自己没有吃月白梨。
没想到兔子一直都有体温，第三天竟然醒来了，而且很爱吃月白梨。
如果不给月白梨，兔子就是吃边上的野草也不会吃另外两种梨的。
兔子吃了没事的第二个月，林鹤清也开始吃月白梨了，确实好吃，吃完神清气爽，更容易进入修炼状态了。
月白梨挂在枝头，如果不加灵液，它就会随着时间流逝自己掉落的，空间里的时间流逝和外面是一样的。
林鹤清每天吃一个，很快就没了，然后他就把灵液兑水，第一次浇三分之一，只开了花没有结果，月白梨的生长周期变长了。
就再浇了三分之一，树上果然结果子了，林鹤清就没有再浇，等吃完再浇。

一直到现在，两只兔子都是吃的月白梨，林鹤清也每天会修炼前吃一个。
值得一提的是，两只兔子吃了这么久月白梨，反而没有繁殖了，一直没有怀过孩子，所以空间里一直就是这两只兔子。
不知道为什么，林鹤清总觉得这两只兔子越来越聪明了，越来越人性化，有时候林鹤清都觉得兔子能听得懂他说话。
发现这个灵液妙用之后，林鹤清每次吃到好吃的水果，总是会把种子种在空间里，进行催生，然后想吃的时候就可以摘一个。
现在空间里已经有好多种水果了，索性空间里渐渐也变大了，出现了山，林鹤清就把这些植株移植到山上去。
话说回来，林鹤清进空间之后先摘了梨喂给两只兔子。
其实不喂也可以，满山的水果自己掉落的时间不同，可以自己去吃。
content_en:
Lin Heqing was only eight years old at that time and raised some rabbits to play with.
I suddenly wanted to see if the ectoplasm had any effect on animals.
So Lin Heqing waited for the four rabbits he bought to give birth to many babies, secretly raised the two rabbits in the space, and fed the rabbits sweet pears that he had improved three times.
Plant a sweet pear seed, add a drop of spiritual liquid, and then pick the sweet pear that bears and eat it.
The seeds obtained were planted again, and another drop of spiritual liquid was added to produce fruit again. Then the seeds were planted again, and a total of three pear trees were obtained.
The first pear tree didn't grow very big, but then there were quite a few. The pears tasted a little sweeter than those outside.
But the fruits of the third pear tree did not taste very sweet, and they did not bear many fruits. One tree only bore twenty pears.
The pears tasted refreshing and crisp. Lin Heqing called the fruit on the third tree "moon white pear". The pears were big, white and round, like the full moon in the sky.
When the rabbits got a little bigger, Lin Heqing used the excuse that he had too many and sold all the rabbits, leaving only two male rabbits in the yard. He fed them occasionally and they grew well.
The female rabbit was so capable of giving birth that Lin Heqing was scared.
In fact, when you have rabbit babies, there are too many babies, and the rabbits will breed again when they get a little older.
Lin Heqing put two rabbits in the space, and no one found them.
When three kinds of pears were fed to rabbits at the same time, the moon white pears were obviously popular. After eating the moon white pears, even if Lin Heqing did not pick the moon white pears in time, the rabbits would not eat the other two pears.
The first time they ate the moon-white pears, the two rabbits enjoyed the meal. However, after eating, the rabbits slept for two days. Lin Heqing thought they were dead and was glad that he did not eat the moon-white pears.
Unexpectedly, the rabbit always had a body temperature, and woke up on the third day, and loved to eat white pears.
If you don't give Yuebai pears, the rabbit will eat the weeds on the side and won't eat the other two kinds of pears.
In the second month after the rabbit was fine, Lin Heqing also started eating Yuebai pears. It was really delicious. After eating it, he felt refreshed and it was easier to enter the state of cultivation.
The moon-white pear is hanging on the branch. If no spiritual liquid is added, it will fall off by itself as time goes by. The passage of time in the space is the same as outside.
Lin Heqing ate one every day, and it was gone soon. Then he mixed the spiritual liquid with water, and poured one-third of it the first time. Only flowers bloomed but no fruit. The growth cycle of the Yuebai pear became longer.
So he watered another third, and the tree did bear fruit. Lin Heqing stopped watering it and waited until it was finished.
Until now, both rabbits have been eating Yuebai pears, and Lin Heqing also eats one every day before practicing.
It is worth mentioning that the two rabbits have eaten Yuebai Pears for so long that they have not reproduced and have never conceived children, so these two rabbits have always been in the space.
For some reason, Lin Heqing always felt that the two rabbits were getting smarter and more humane. Sometimes Lin Heqing felt that the rabbits could understand him.
After discovering the magical effect of this spiritual liquid, every time Lin Heqing ate delicious fruit, he would always plant the seeds in the space to promote growth, and then he could pick one when he wanted to eat.
Now there are many kinds of fruits in the space, and the space gradually becomes larger, and mountains appear. Lin Heqing transplants these plants to the mountains.
Having said that, after Lin Heqing entered the space, he first picked pears and fed them to the two rabbits.
In fact, it’s okay not to feed them. The fruits all over the mountain fall at different times, so you can eat them by yourself.
